valueIdentity: value per 650 PA = bat + fielding(position) + positional adjustment
caveats: The difficulty matrix D is identified ONLY on players who played two positions in the same season. That population is selected, and the correction applied here (subtracting the s(p)*glove part before refitting) is a model-based correction, not a randomisation.

An average glove is worth the same at every fielding position: the ladder's own difficulty prices the move (one run scale), so a gain between two fielding positions is the player's glove alone, and only a move to DH carries a league-wide part.
The positional ladder is Baseball-Reference's, recovered by inverting its positional runs.
Catcher has no Savant OAA in any season and is never scored.
Year-over-year persistence is a LOWER bound on within-season reliability, so the glove is over-shrunk and the model under-flags.

The gain SE covers glove, difficulty and ladder uncertainty. It does NOT cover idiosyncratic conversion risk (a specific player's hands, arm, or instincts failing to transfer), which is unmeasurable here.
Playing time is priced per 650 PA. A demotion that also costs the player playing time, or that is blocked by an incumbent, is a roster question this model does not answer.

rngMeta.scale: 100 + 10z on the current-season MLB position-player pool
rngMeta.note: Display only. Sprint speed is not a model input: OAA already contains the legs, so adding it would double-count.

ladder.units: runs per 650 PA, relative to the league average defensive position
ladder.method: least squares of BRef runs_position/650PA on innings shares, no intercept, recentred to exposure-weighted sum zero

folkloreBasis.caveat: the folklore table is quoted per 162 games in some sources and per 600-700 PA in others, and it is the FanGraphs/Tango ladder while this fit inverts Baseball-Reference, so both columns are published and neither is presented as the answer

identification.zero_means: the average defensive position of a qualified player-season, every fitted player-season counted once: the weights are the column means of the per-row innings shares, not league innings totals
identification.uncentred_level_equals: mean(runs_position per 650 PA) over the fitted rows
identification.why_equal_weight_sums_are_not_zero: DH is 8.8% of exposure, not a ninth, so equal-weighting the nine rungs over-counts the DH penalty; and with the exposure-weighted sum pinned at zero the eight fielding rungs must sum to -8 x w_DH x L_DH / (1 - w_DH). Only the exposure-weighted sum is a constraint - the other two are consequences of it.

ladderV2.summary: Refuted pending re-read: beat the Baseball-Reference inversion, but an all-zero fielding ladder scores within 0.049 runs per 650 PA (CI95 -0.005 to 0.103). Not served.

oneScale.rule: value at a fielding position = mean7(ladder) + s(p) x glove z x innings/1000; at DH = ladder(DH)

demotionNull.labelDefinition: moved_down = the StatsAPI most-innings position in t+1 sits lower on the fitted positional ladder than the one in t, by more than 0.5 runs per 650 PA. The scored quantity is the DEMOTION gain, not the best-of-all gain: a promotion needs the job to be open, a demotion does not.
